_source: Copied from WMT terminal data.js DEFAULT_INDICATORS (definitions only, no values)

models.name: KMRI
models.label: Koch Macro Resilience Index
models.desc: Flagship model: kinetic tension + macro fear + food/energy stress + insurance/war-risk tone. Higher = broader multi-domain risk.
models.summary: Main score for “how stressed is the world right now?”

models.name: GSI
models.label: Geopolitical Stress Index
models.desc: Hotspot heat + crisis news + risk-asset tone.

models.name: TSI
models.label: Tension Score Index
models.desc: Theater posture + tensions layer + great-power keywords.

models.name: FSI
models.label: Food Security Index
models.desc: Wheat/cocoa/food basket pressure + ag region stress + Black Sea risk.

models.name: ERI
models.label: Energy Risk Index
models.desc: Oil/gas moves + Gulf/Red Sea/Black Sea energy-adjacent stress.

models.name: IRI
models.label: Insurance Risk Proxy
models.desc: War-risk + CAT proxies + marine corridor stress.

models.name: CPR
models.label: Commodity Pressure Ratio
models.summary: When many commodity prices rise together.

models.name: ROR
models.label: Risk-On / Risk-Off
models.desc: −100 risk-off … +100 risk-on from crypto/equity vs gold/fear.

models.name: NVI
models.label: News Velocity Index
models.desc: Headline throughput scaled — spikes often lead tape moves.

models.name: CCI
models.label: Crisis Convergence
models.desc: Co-firing of elevated theaters, critical alerts, strong quakes.

models.name: SPI
models.label: Stability Path Index
models.desc: Constructive-stability model: lower kinetic + higher risk-on + cooler insurance = more room for positive paths. Higher SPI = more constructive headroom.
models.summary: Room for things to get better (higher is better).

models.name: OSI
models.label: Open-Source Intensity
models.desc: Live public signal density: news velocity + crisis tone + disaster/quake heat.
models.summary: How loud the news feed is.

models.name: IIS
models.label: Infrastructure Integrity Stress
models.desc: Overall power-grid, telecom, and outage stress. Higher = more fragile electricity and networks.
models.summary: Power grid, telecom, and outage stress.

_note: KMRI = Koch Macro Resilience Index (per Dr. Benjamin Koch). The terminal UI itself still labels it "Kinetic-Macro Risk Index" in data.js; that file was not modified.
